steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Exact values table: sin/cos/tan for 0, pi/6, pi/4, pi/3, pi/2

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Double angle: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A, cos 2A = cos^2A - sin^2A = 2cos^2A-1 = 1-2sin^2A

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: R-formula: a sin θ + b cos θ = R sin(θ + α) where R = sqrt(a^2+b^2), tan α = b/a

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Solve 2 sin 2θ = sqrt3 cos θ for 0 <= θ < 2pi --- Solution: 2(2 sin θ cos θ) = sqrt3 cos θ -> cos θ(4 sin θ - sqrt3) = 0. cos θ = 0 -> θ = pi/2, 3pi/2. sin θ = sqrt3/4 ≈ 0.433 -> θ ≈ 0.448, 2.694

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Prove: tan 2θ = 2tan θ/(1 - tan^2θ) | Solve 3 cos 2θ + sin θ = 1 for 0 <= θ < 360 deg | Express 3 sin θ + 4 cos θ as R sin(θ + α)
